question: My Manitoba Hydro electricity bill says the latest meter reading was 'estimated.' Does that mean a reader physically visited my meter, and what can I check?
generated_answer: Manitoba Hydro's meter readers visit your meter to record the amount of electricity you have used. You can check the accuracy of your bill by comparing the current reading on your meter to the reading on your bill. If the reading on your meter is higher than the one on your bill, you have used more electricity than your bill indicates. If the reading on your meter is lower than the one on your bill, you have used less electricity than your bill indicates. If the reading on your meter is significantly different than the one on your bill, please contact Manitoba Hydro to report the discrepancy.
